definitions.explanation: A place where two or more roads meet or cross.

examples.japanese: {交差点|こうさてん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{事故|じこ}→事故：00851_jiko⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦あった→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There was an accident at the intersection.

examples.japanese: {交差点|こうさてん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{右|みぎ}→右：02257_migi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{曲|ま}がって→曲がる：00649_magaru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please turn right at the intersection.

examples.japanese: ⟦{次|つぎ}→次：00819_tsugi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{交差点|こうさてん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{左|ひだり}→左：00628_hidari⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{曲|ま}がって→曲がる：00649_magaru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please turn left at the next intersection.

notes:
{交差点|こうさてん} refers to where two or more roads cross. Essential for giving and understanding directions.
